{{DISPLAYTITLE:Lamia (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-Lamia.gif|left]]
[[File:FFTALamia.jpg|right|250px]]
{{Quote|Lamias lure prey with sweet songs...watch out!|Description}}
The '''Lamia''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a red snake-like creature with similar qualities to Lamia from previous ''[[Final Fantasy series|Final Fantasy]]'' games. Its skills are notorious for inflicting a myriad of [[status effect]]s.

{{See|Lamia}}
